subject.title: Subagent announce give-up (retry-limit/expiry) does not wake parent waiting on sessions_yield → permanent deadlock

question: Should the retry-count, retry-delay, and expiry knobs requested here become public configuration, or should the fix stay focused on durable synthetic completion/wake behavior using existing constants?
rationale: The parent-wake behavior is a bug fix, but exposing retry and expiry knobs grows the public config surface and AGENTS.md sets a high bar for new config options.

options.title: Keep Config Internal
options.body: Land the wake/tool-result repair without new public retry or expiry knobs, and revisit configurability only if operational evidence remains after the durable handoff fix.

options.title: Add Narrow Config
options.body: Approve a small documented config surface for announce retry limits and expiry, with schema/help/docs/tests and no runtime compatibility shim.

options.title: Defer Entire Direction
options.body: Pause retry/expiry configuration until the durable queued announcement design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94153 is decided.

recommendation.title: Keep Config Internal
recommendation.body: Land the wake/tool-result repair without new public retry or expiry knobs, and revisit configurability only if operational evidence remains after the durable handoff fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history across the subagent lifecycle and docs paths and is the likely owner for the config/product boundary.
